title: Agents, one market and a single event heap
subtitle: Agents act only through the Market and hear about the world through callbacks. Click a stage for details.

steps.name: Scheduler
steps.role: A heap of (time, seq, fn, args). Pops the earliest event, sets t, calls fn
details: Every agent schedules its own wake-ups, cancels and markout checks here

parallel.name: Fundamental
parallel.role: V follows a random walk with jumps, stepping every fund_dt
details: Read by the informed traders and by the analysis stamps on each trade, nothing else

parallel.name: Informed
parallel.role: Reads V plus noise, trades when V is outside the quote

parallel.name: NoiseLiquidity
parallel.role: Joins at or behind the best, cancels after an exponential wait

steps.name: Market
steps.role: Order entry, trade stamping and fan-out
details: Stamps mid_before and V on each trade
Appends the trade to the tape
Calls on_fill() on maker and taker, then every trade listener

steps.name: MarketMaker
details: Fair value and an inventory skew
Requotes on trades and on a timer

steps.name: Recorder
steps.role: Every sample_dt, t, V, bid, ask, mid, spread, last, and the maker's inventory, wealth and spread
